scope: Bounded read-only candidate trial; no product adoption or phone test
mocMethod: Read FITS BINTABLE UNIQ unsigned big-endian 1J rows; decode order=floor((bit_length(uniq)-3)/2) and nested pixel=uniq-4*4^order; expand each row to half-open intervals at common order 11, merge intervals, count overlap and union against 12*4^11 full-sky cells. Individual computed fractions match source properties to 4 digits.

order8ActualTiles.visualObservation: Sombrero appears in both order-8 tiles; PS1 and SkyMapper color/stretch and source artifacts differ substantially. SkyMapper LMC tile shows a conspicuous yellow-green strip/mosaic artifact. Neither coverage map nor download success establishes visual quality. Images visually inspected in ignored artifacts/miniapp/cloud-sky-native/optical-hips-{ps1,skymapper}-{sombrero,m31,lmc}-order8.*

geometryTrial.candidateLibrary: healpix-ts@1.1.0 (MIT, 476259 unpacked bytes, no declared dependencies); installed only under ignored artifacts/miniapp/cloud-sky-native/hips-trial, not product dependencies
geometryTrial.mapping: pixcoord2VecNest(nside, ipix, ne, nw) with source JPEG/PNG normalized image x=ne and top-down y=nw is consistent with Sombrero and M31 sky positions within their actual sample tiles; final registration still requires reference/WCS cross-check.
geometryTrial.method: Compare HEALPix exact vector at a 21x21 grid with normalized affine interpolation of the three source corner rays (0,0),(1,0),(0,1), as required by current registerSkyArtwork plane. Angular errors converted using approximate 58.6°/(2^order*512) angular pixel scale, so pixel numbers are indicative rather than a final screen-error bound.

triangularMeshTrial.method: Regular per-tile cells, two triangles; compare normalized barycentric direction at cell center and quarter points with exact pixcoord2VecNest; approximate tile pixels from 58.6 degrees / 2^order / 512.
triangularMeshTrial.limitation: These are sampled sphere-direction errors, not final screen projection, horizon clipping, performance or measured image registration.

geometryTrial.decision: Current three-anchor TAN/artwork registration cannot map low-order HiPS as one plane. A multi-vertex mesh or equivalent exact HEALPix inverse mapping sharing current camera/texture lifecycle is needed; test distortion and edge continuity before page adoption. No second sky camera or image manager.

limits: MOC coverage does not establish image quality, seam color, depth at all orders, allowed production redistribution, complete full sky, native rendering or target-device performance. One order-0 SkyMapper tile is mostly black because that tile is mostly outside its footprint. Order-8 sample shows an actual LMC artifact. No product integration or phone use.
